hero.eyebrow: Dr. Mohamed Gamil · Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation Specialist
hero.title: Movement begins with understanding.
hero.description: I help you understand your condition and restore movement with confidence through a clear, personalized care plan.

philosophy.title: Treatment does not begin with an exercise. It begins with understanding the person who moves.
philosophy.description: In my practice, pain is not treated as an isolated symptom that needs a quick fix. I begin by understanding how you move, live, and function, then we build a clear path toward stronger and more confident movement.
philosophy.imageAlt: Dr. Mohamed Gamil during his professional practice

listening.title: Listen First
listening.description: Understanding your movement history, habits, and individual constraints before deciding on an intervention.

transparency.title: Understand What Is Happening
transparency.description: Clear, practical explanations of movement and the body so you can take an active role in your recovery.

progression.title: Progress Toward Independence
progression.description: A structured progression that builds strength, capacity, and confidence for long-term movement.

finalCta.title: Your first step toward a calm, precise, and lasting recovery starts today.
finalCta.description: Book a comprehensive one-on-one kinematic evaluation with Dr. Mohamed Gamil, establishing a transparent roadmap back to full movement confidence.
